Clockwork_Air_Intake_Vents.description: The intricate Clockwork Air Intake Vents, situated at the apex of the cephalon, are a marvel of mechanical engineering, allowing the construct to breathe in a constant supply of purified air that enhances its endurance and grants it the ability to perform tirelessly without succumbing to fatigue.

Crystal_Arcane_Sniffer_Prism.description: This crystalline cephalon, a marvel of arcane engineering, boasts a sensitive nose capable of detecting the faintest magical scents and tracking them with uncanny precision, enhancing its wielder's perception and wisdom in the process.

Steam_Exhaust_Nozzle.description: Emerging from the construct's cephalon, this menacing steam exhaust nozzle hisses and spews scalding vapor, its constant emission a chilling reminder of the infernal machinery housed within, simultaneously granting an aura of searing heat and reducing the construct's charisma while bolstering its resilience.

Gargoyle_Stone_Nostrils.description: Carved from a single block of obsidian-hard stone, the Gargoyle's nostrils are cold, lifeless pits that seem to draw in the very essence of the night, enhancing the gargoyle's resilience and fortitude, while granting it an uncanny resistance to being pushed or knocked off its perch.

Necrotic_Stitched_Pig_Snout.description: This macabre construct, a necrotic pig snout stitched from desiccated flesh and sinew, enhances the wearer's keen sense of smell, allowing them to track foes and uncover secrets hidden by darkness, yet its unnatural presence sours their charisma, drawing fear and revulsion from those around them.

Porcelain_Doll_Button_Nose.description: This delicate porcelain nose, crafted with meticulous detail, protrudes from the face of a doll-like construct, its smooth, pale surface catching the light with an almost lifelike sheen, though it subtly diminishes the wearer's perception while dramatically enhancing their charisma.

Scrap_Metal_Pipe_Snout.description: Welded from scavenged metal scraps, the Scrap Metal Pipe Snout is a crude yet functional cephalon augmentation, enhancing the bearer's perception and constitution while granting resistance to knockback, its hollow structure resonating ominously with each step.

Living_Wood_Root_Snout.description: The Living Wood Root Snout is a twisted, arboreal construct that sprouts a gnarled, bark-covered snout from the earth, capable of both burrowing and sensing its surroundings with an uncanny accuracy, its innate connection to the natural world granting it a form of regeneration and the ability to track scents even through solid stone.

Skeletal_Undead_Nasal_Cavity.description: Hollowed out and filled with an unsettling echo, the skeletal nasal cavity serves as a conduit for the malevolent essence that animates its undead host, diminishing the creature’s charisma while sharpening its senses to detect the faintest of movements, and whispering the secrets of fear into the hearts of the living.

Cybernetic_Chemical_Filter_Nose.description: A sleek, cybernetic nose, grafted into the cephalon, buzzes with an internal filtration system that purifies air of toxins and poisons, enhancing the construct's constitution and granting immunity to poison, its metallic sheen a testament to its advanced engineering.
